articles.title: BJP govt has 'failed' first test of accountability by not seeking Pradhan's resignation: Kharge
articles.summary: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge criticized the BJP government, accusing it of failing accountability by not asking Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan to resign. Kharge questioned the government's inaction amidst ongoing controversies surrounding exam irregularities, such as NEET/NET. This political attack underscores a larger debate about transparency and governance in India's education sector, highlighting the opposition's demand for greater governmental responsibility.

articles.title: Exercise Pitch Black 2026: India to participate in one of the largest aerial wargames in Australia
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force (IAF) is actively participating in Exercise Pitch Black 2026, a significant multinational aerial wargame in Australia's Northern Territory. This exercise brings together over 100 aircraft and thousands of personnel from 20 nations, including India. The IAF's involvement in these complex combat scenarios enhances interoperability, refines tactical skills, and strengthens strategic cooperation with global partners, crucial for modern defence preparedness.

articles.title: NEET re-exam papers to be transported by Army helicopter from Madurai to Tirunelveli; how NTA enforces 7-layer security shield across exam system
articles.summary: The National Testing Agency (NTA) is utilizing an Army helicopter to transport NEET re-examination papers from Madurai to Tirunelveli. This is part of NTA's stringent 7-layer security shield implemented for the exam. The move underscores serious efforts to ensure the integrity and fairness of the crucial examination amidst recent controversies, showcasing a robust approach to secure national testing processes.

articles.title: NEET-UG 2026 re-exam: Indian Army helicopter to transport question papers to Tirunelveli amid tight security
articles.summary: An Indian Army helicopter recently conducted a trial landing at Tirunelveli Armed Reserve Ground in Tamil Nadu. This exercise is part of preparations to securely transport NEET-UG 2026 question papers. The Army's involvement underscores its diverse operational capabilities beyond traditional defence, providing crucial logistical support for national civilian events, ensuring the integrity and timely conduct of vital examinations across the country.

articles.title: When the Soviet Venera 13 probe touched down on Venus in March 1982, it survived for 127 minutes in a 465-degree atmosphere that crushed it with the pressure of nearly a kilometre of ocean water, and in that time it scraped a soil sample, analysed it, and transmitted the first colour photographs ever taken from the surface of another planet.
articles.summary: On March 1, 1982, the Soviet Union's Venera 13 probe made history by successfully landing on Venus. Despite the planet's incredibly hostile atmosphere, which attempted to crush the car-sized spacecraft, it managed to deploy its cameras and transmit the first-ever color photographs directly from Venus's surface. This mission represented a monumental achievement in space exploration, showcasing advanced scientific and engineering capabilities in understanding our solar system.
